visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair and a light green turtleneck sweater holds a smartphone in a mirror-like selfie angle. She smiles warmly and makes a peace sign with her left hand. To her right, a young toddler with short dark hair sits in a light-colored stroller, looking curiously at the camera lens. The background shows blurred interior lighting of what appears to be a retail store or mall hallway with white walls and soft overhead lights. (2) The woman maintains her smiling expression while interacting vocally with the child. The child's facial expressions change as he attempts to speak, looking around the environment and then back at the camera. The camera remains static as it captures the pair's reflection. Large text overlays in Chinese and Japanese characters appear frequently at the center and bottom of the frame, accompanied by emojis. (3) The scene continues with the woman leaning slightly closer to the child, encouraging him with her gaze. The child points or shifts his gaze away from the camera as if searching for something in the distance. The warm indoor lighting remains constant, casting soft highlights on their faces and the metallic frame of the stroller. The video concludes with a close-up feeling of a personal family moment captured in a public shopping space.
